title: The Art of Reading Grain: Selecting Slabs Like a Pro
description: How to pick the perfect slab — character, figure, and all the things that separate furniture timber from firewood. Hazy and Plummo debate their favourite species and share the secrets that took years to learn.

title: Bloke Check-In: Mental Health in the Trades
description: A raw and honest chat about what it means to be a man in a trade — depression, isolation, and how to ask for help without feeling soft.

title: Chainsaw Mills: Worth the Hype?
description: Three portable chainsaw mills tested head-to-head straight from the paddock. Hazy and Plummo give you the honest verdict.

title: Women in the Workshop — Guest: Sarah Langford
description: Sarah runs one of NSW's most respected custom furniture studios and shares how she's built a career in a male-dominated industry.

title: Resin: The Good, The Bad & The Ugly
description: Everything you wanted to know about high-clarity epoxy resin casting — from prep and pouring to the horror stories of what can go wrong.

title: Back Pain, Hearing Loss & Workshop Safety
description: The occupational health hazards that woodworkers ignore until it's too late. Dr. Mike Parrish joins to explain what you need to know.

title: Australian Hardwoods: A Field Guide
description: Ironbark, Blackwood, Huon Pine, Red Cedar — Plummo and Hazy break down the character and working properties of iconic Aussie species.

title: Setting Up Your First Real Workshop
description: From a back shed with a jigsaw to a proper setup — the decisions, the spend, and the order of operations that actually make sense.

title: The Social Media Woodworker: Is It Worth It?
description: Hazy and Plummo get personal about how building an audience online changed their businesses — the good, the grind, and the weird side.

title: Hand Tools vs Power Tools: The Real Debate
description: Both hosts take a side and argue it hard. Who wins? That's for the listeners to decide. Spoiler: it gets heated.
